caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object centrally placed against a plain, cream-colored background with a thin brown rectangular border. The object appears to be a brownish metallic container with an angular, trapezoidal body, a hinged or overlapped lid with small perforated holes, and a long, slender, straight handle attached to one side. The metallic surface of the object shows a variated texture, with shades of brown and bluish-gray indicating dented or worn areas, and the entire container sits at an angle, casting a subtle shadow underneath. The artist’s signature "Samuel Fineman Del. 1861" is written in brown ink in the bottom right corner outside the main drawing area.
title: Coal Carrier
